messages:
Isabel (EMEA SDR): Morning all 12 I joined last week but still missing a couple things for the EMEA play: HubSpot regional queues, Dialpad EU number, and the local case studies folder. Who's the right contact to sort EU numbers + printed one-sheets?

onboarding-bot: Welcome Isabel (EMEA SDR) to #sales! You've been added to the EMEA cohort and assigned a buddy: Mateo. See your onboarding checklist in email.

Tom (Sales Ops): Hi Isabel 12 for EU Dialpad numbers we provision from the telecom pool. Can you confirm your preferred country and whether you need a direct DID or shared queue extension? Also what's your preferred caller ID (team vs personal)?

Isabel (EMEA SDR): Spain preferred (+34) and I'd like a direct DID. Caller ID should show "Redwood - EMEA". Also, where's the EMEA case studies folder? The links in the bundle pointed to US-specific examples.

Ben (IT): @Isabel I started the DID request. Telecom usually takes 24-48h for provisioning and number porting. For now I enabled web softphone so you can make/receive calls immediately. If you want a desk phone later file a hardware request.

Claire (Enablement): Isabel 12 apologies for the US links. I just created a localized collection: Drive > Sales > EMEA_Case_Studies and added Spanish and German PDFs. Quick link: https://redwood.link/emea-cases. Also uploaded a one-sheet pack and a printable A6 quick-card you can order via the merch portal.

Isabel (EMEA SDR): Thanks! The softphone is working but calls show my personal email in HubSpot call logs. Is there an SSO/connect step to map caller to Redwood account?

Ben (IT): The HubSpot call logging relies on the Dialpad integration. I reconnected the integration and cleared the OAuth token for your account; try making a test outbound call and check the activity feed. If the log still shows a personal email, send a screenshot.

Isabel (EMEA SDR): Test call made, HubSpot now logs it as isabel@redwood.ai and shows the call note. Perfect. One more: any short scripts for timezone-aware outreach? I want something tuned for late-afternoon CET cadences.

Claire (Enablement): We have a "EMEA Afternoon Cadence" play in Confluence with A/B subject lines and a 3-touch sequence optimized for CET. Link: https://redwood.link/emea-afternoon-cadence. Also uploaded localized opener snippets that reference EU privacy controls and data residency points.

Tom (Sales Ops): Sending you a physical one-sheet to the London office address on file; if you'd prefer home delivery DM me. Also added you to the HubSpot queue "EMEA - Outbound" and the Dialpad DID provisioning ticket #TEL-457.

Isabel (EMEA SDR): All set 12 saw the queue and the ticket. Appreciate the speedy help everyone. I'll sync with Mateo tomorrow morning for shadowing. :party_parrot:

onboarding-bot: System: ticket #TEL-457 updated: Dialpad DID requested for +34 provision.
